description: Built-in Type-C Cable: No more hunting for cables. The integrated tangle-free Type-C cable stays with your power bank at all times — pull it out, plug in, go. Works with iPhones (USB-C), Android, earbuds, and more. 22.5W Super Fast Charging (PD + QC): Charges your phone at nearly 3x the speed of a standard 10W adapter. USB-C PD for laptops, tablets & iPhones — USB-C QC for Android. Gets your phone from 0 to 50% in 30 minutes. Charge 3 Devices at Once: 2 USB-C ports + 1 USB-A port let you power your phone, earbuds, and smartwatch simultaneously — no juggling, no waiting. Total output intelligently distributed across all connected devices. BIS Certified & Safety-First: One of the few power banks in this class with BIS certification — independently verified for Indian safety standards. Built-in overcharge, short circuit, over-temperature, and over-discharge protection keeps your devices safe every charge. LED Display + Metallic Build: Shows exact battery percentage with a digital display. Metal body helps with heat dissipation during charging.
